blocks.text: Pelajaran ini tentang jumlah: «perlu berapa kacang pekan?», «kami punya sedikit waktu luang», «kami kurang privasi», «kita perlu dua kantong beras». Yang penting: bendanya bisa dihitung satu per satu atau tidak.

examples.en: How many pecans do we need?
We have a little leisure time.
We have little privacy.
We need two bags of rice.

blocks.text: Ada benda yang dihitung satu per satu: a bookend, two ottomans — untuk satu pakai a atau an, setelah two tambah -s. Bahasa Indonesia bilang «dua puf» tanpa perubahan, bahasa Inggris wajib -s. Crockery, gravel, housework tidak dihitung: tanpa a dan -s.

examples.en: This is a bookend.
There are two ottomans in the room.
This crockery is new.
This is an errand.
This housework is tiring.

fixes.wrong: There are two ottoman in the room.
fixes.right: There are two ottomans in the room.

fixes.wrong: There are a two ottomans in the room.
fixes.right: There are two ottomans in the room.

drill.why: Butir lada dihitung satu per satu: setelah two pakai -s, tanpa a.

blocks.text: Bahasa Indonesia cukup «berapa», bahasa Inggris punya dua. Bisa dihitung — many: How many pecans? Tidak bisa — much: How much polenta? Dengan «tidak» juga: We don't have much semolina. Sebelum many dan much tidak ada a.

examples.en: How many pecans do we need?
How much polenta do we need?
We don't have much semolina.
How many commuters use this train?
examples.translation: Berapa orang naik kereta ini untuk ke kantor?

examples.en: How much congestion is there today?

fixes.wrong: How much pecans do we need?
fixes.right: How many pecans do we need?

fixes.wrong: How many polenta do we need?
fixes.right: How much polenta do we need?

fixes.wrong: How a many pecans do we need?
fixes.right: How many pecans do we need?

drill.question: Kamu menghitung tugas kursus — bisa dihitung satu per satu. Bagaimana bertanya?
drill.optionA: How much assignments do we have?
drill.optionB: How many assignments do we have?

blocks.text: Sedikit tapi ada: a few untuk yang dihitung, a little untuk yang tidak. We have a few housemates — «kami punya beberapa teman serumah». We have a little leisure time — «kami punya sedikit waktu luang».

examples.en: We have a few housemates.
We have a little leisure time.
We received a few compliments.
We have a little quinoa.

fixes.wrong: We have a few leisure time.
fixes.right: We have a little leisure time.

blocks.text: Hapus a, artinya berubah: «sedikit, kurang dari yang diharapkan». We have little privacy — «kami kurang privasi». I have few contact numbers — «nomor kontak saya sedikit». a few / a little — «ada sedikit», few / little — «kurang».

examples.en: We have little privacy.
We received little encouragement.
I have few contact numbers.
We have little buckwheat left.
I received a few voice messages.

drill.why: Tidak dihitung dan «kurang» — little tanpa a.

blocks.text: Kalimat biasa pakai some: We sent some job applications. Dengan «tidak» dan dalam pertanyaan pakai any: We don't have any contact details; Do you need any childcare? Bisa untuk yang dihitung maupun tidak.

examples.en: We sent some job applications.
We don't have any contact details.
examples.translation: Kami tidak punya data kontak apa pun.

examples.en: Do you need any childcare?
There aren't any service charges.
Is there any public parking here?

fixes.wrong: We don't have some contact details.
fixes.right: We don't have any contact details.

sections.title: Dua kantong, dua liter: two bags of…

blocks.text: Yang tidak bisa dihitung, dihitung lewat kemasan dan takaran: two bags of rice, two litres of milk. Bahasa Indonesia cukup «dua kantong beras», bahasa Inggris: kantongnya pakai -s dan di tengah wajib of.

examples.en: We need two tubes of toothpaste.
examples.translation: Kita perlu dua tube pasta gigi.

examples.en: We need two bars of soap.
We need two bags of rice.
We need two litres of milk.
I need two pieces of advice.

fixes.right: We need two bags of rice.

fixes.wrong: We need two tube of toothpaste.
fixes.right: We need two tubes of toothpaste.

sections.title: Kesalahan yang dibuat hampir semua orang

fixes.wrong: There are two ottoman in the room.
fixes.right: There are two ottomans in the room.

fixes.wrong: How much pecans do we need?
fixes.right: How many pecans do we need?

fixes.wrong: We have a few leisure time.
fixes.right: We have a little leisure time.
We need two bags of rice.

blocks.text: Tanya dulu: bisa dihitung satu per satu? Ya — a, -s, many, a few. Tidak — tanpa a dan -s, much, a little; untuk menghitung pakai kemasan dan of.
Dihitung — many, a few, few. Tidak dihitung — much, a little, little. Dengan a — «ada sedikit», tanpa a — «kurang». Some di kalimat biasa, any dengan «tidak» dan di pertanyaan. Kemasan + s + of.

examples.en: How much knowledge do we need?
I need a little personal space.
We need two slices of cheese.
